invariants.rationale: The method returns 'records' after sorting in place, so the returned value is the same object reference.
'records' is returned, so 'result' is non-null if input is non-null; null records input is unlikely by method contract.
Sorting reorders elements in-place without changing the size, and the returned result is the same list.
List.size() is always non-negative by Java specification.
'outputPartitions' parameter is expected to be non-negative, as negative partitions do not make sense logically.
